GET_USER_INTENTS:
query GetUserIntents($user: EthAddress!, $status: IntentStatus, $limit: Int, $offset: Int, $fresh: Boolean) {
  userIntents(
    user: $user
    status: $status
    limit: $limit
    offset: $offset
    fresh: $fresh
  ) {
    id
    user
    createdTxHash
    createdBlock
    updatedBlock
    createdAt
    updatedAt
    ...IntentItem
  }
}

fragment IntentItem on Intent {
  tokenFrom
  tokenTo
  amount
  priceThreshold
  status
  expiration
}
